label: Explicit finite interpretations distinguish ordinary support from…, by Constructive-proof
meaning: Finite structured controls: role favoring can be fallible and fail to produce belief; goal-relative force can exist at the actual preference without preference-independent force; bare production/reward need not yield an ordinary-role reason; all four calibrations can coexist; a genuine remaining profile and missing-presentation control expose the exact coverage/representation burdens. No actual normative instance is established.
